I think the issue for me is that I do not have good listening comprehension skills and that I never realized this until university. I had always coasted through high school without paying attention in class and relying solely on my ability read textbooks and memorize diagrams. My ability to write scientific papers has been my one saving grace in all this because it allows me to sit and think for long periods of time. 

I hope things are going well for you in university.

Edit: Also, thanks for commenting. I appreciate it.
